messages.subject: Pro for the ops team
messages.text:
Hi Shlomi,

Thanks for the demo. We have budget set aside for Q1 and want to roll out to about 40 people in operations. Our biggest problem is that dispatch still runs on spreadsheets and we lose jobs every week.

I'm the one driving this, but Raj Patel (our CFO) signs anything over $20k. Could you send pricing for Pro?

Dana Lee
VP Operations, Acme

messages.subject: Re: Pro for the ops team
messages.text:
Thanks Dana. I'll send pricing and a case study from a logistics customer by Thursday.

Shlomi

messages.subject: Re: Pro for the ops team
messages.text:
Adding Raj. We also need SSO before go-live, that's a hard requirement from IT. We're looking at Globex as well. We want a decision by end of November.

Dana
